regions.merged_text: Many thanks for kind rememberance. Haven't been here since April 25th. Sorry I missed you. I received word from Mr. Stanton wrote me of your flight to Europe - and shortly after came your cards. · I hope by this time he believes more in his Patron . - St. Anton. ! Best Wishes.
